coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 11 ground-truth items (18%): measuring pipeline bubble rate and comparing ZB-2p against theoretical scheduler predictions. Other items are missing, materially changed, or only partially represented.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the fixed 14.6B model, 16 pipeline stages, and 64 microbatches with a broad configuration sweep. Gives a generic 2p memory setting rather than the specified enable flag and fixed limit of 32. Uses Nsight capture but omits nsys export and custom Python/SVG processing. Does not explicitly use the ideal complete-overlap baseline or compare computed and profiled stage timelines for alignment. Reports throughput in TFLOPs/sec/GPU rather than samples/sec/GPU.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected near-zero bubble result (below 1% in most settings), minor real-world overhead caveat, and supporting high throughput and tight timeline alignment.
